Bettina, I saved the draft to June Osei-Lark (joseilark@pemberline.com) with the subject "PHL label cleanup". It's in your mailbox and hasn't been sent.

It includes Sofia's three points and your clarification that the Pellucid rows are the Gulf Coast terminal rows and the Pellow rows are the Mid-Atlantic home goods appointments.

I also dropped the line I added to Sofia's draft earlier suggesting the saved report title be updated. That was my suggestion, not something from Sofia's brief, so I didn't want it going to June as if it were a decision. If you want it back in, tell me and I'll add it.
